subject: Discovery recap: Observability & evals \u0014 dashboards, tracing hooks, golden prompts
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@zenhealth.com>, Devon Patel <devon.patel@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap: Observability & evals  dashboards, tracing hooks, golden prompts

Hi Samantha / Devon,

Thanks again for taking the time today  great conversation. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Key pain points you shared:
- Lack of visibility into model regressions after deploys (false positives/negatives hitting production)
- No centralized dashboards tying inference latency/cost to quality metrics
- Need for guarded rollouts and automated rollback when golden prompt performance drops

Current stack you mentioned:
- Inference currently on AWS EKS with a mix of hosted endpoints and self-hosted models
- Logging to CloudWatch; limited tracing between app -> model -> caching layer
- Existing evals are ad-hoc Jupyter notebooks and a single QA test-suite

Success criteria for a successful eval (what you told us):
- Dashboard showing per-route latency, token cost, and quality (accuracy/QA pass-rate)
- Tracing hooks to correlate user session -> request -> model version -> KV cache hits
- Golden prompt set and regression alerting (alert if pass-rate drops > 5% vs baseline)
- Safe rollout guardrails (canary + auto-fallback to previous model if regression detected)

What Redwood will deliver for the POC / eval:
- Shared dashboard mockup (attached) and a one-week sandbox with sample tracing instrumentation
- Eval checklist (attached) covering golden prompts, load profile, sequence lengths, and edge-case tests
- A recommended rollout policy (canary thresholds, monitoring hooks, automatic fallback)

Next steps (proposed):
1) You review the attached eval checklist and dashboard mockup  tell us if anything’s missing by EOD Wed 8/5.
2) Rishi will provision a sandbox + tracing hooks for your dev team by Fri 8/7.
3) Schedule a kickoff working session for the eval week  suggested slots: Tue 8/11 or Wed 8/12.

Attachments: zenhealth-eval-checklist.xlsx, observability-dashboard-mockup.png

If that all looks right I’ll get the sandbox started and loop in the infra folks.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@zenhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Devon Patel <devon.patel@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-03T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Observability & evals  dashboards, tracing hooks, golden prompts

Thanks Marissa  really helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side:
- The primary KPI for the first phase is the QA pass-rate on our clinical triage prompts (we can provide the golden set).
- For sequence lengths, our median is ~128 tokens but we have long tail requests to 2k+ (rare).
- We’ll need RBAC access for the dashboard for product and security reviewers.

We reviewed the attachments briefly  the checklist looks good but can you add a row for "data retention and access logs"? Security will want that scoping.

On timing: Fri 8/7 for the sandbox sounds good. For the kickoff, Tue 8/11 AM PT works well for product + engineering.

I’ll loop in our Security lead (cc’ing Devon) if we need an extra call around retention.

Best,
Samantha
Head of Product | ZenHealth
samantha.lee@zenhealth.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@zenhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-03T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Observability & evals  dashboards, tracing hooks, golden prompts

Thanks  quick technical notes from my side: 
- Tracing hooks: we’ll provide a lightweight SDK (Python/Node) to emit request_id, user_id (hashed), model_version, kv_cache_hit, and latency buckets. Those map directly to the dashboard panels.
- Long-tail sequences: we recommend sampling a small % of >1k token requests for evaluation to keep costs bounded; we can seed the sandbox with a synthetic set that mirrors your 2k cases.
- Golden prompt set: please upload as CSV to the Drive link Marissa shared. We’ll run baseline evals against current model and report pass-rate + token cost.
- Rollout guardrails: propose canary at 5% traffic, detect regression >5% drop in pass-rate OR 2x increase in p95 latency for 3 consecutive 10-minute buckets -> auto-fallback.

I’ll start provisioning the sandbox tonight and share credentials (read-only dashboard + write-only eval API keys) by EOD Fri. Monica  added you for visibility on the kickoff and any compliance asks.

Rishi
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
